title: Vote on finer grained read restrictions in the Iceberg REST Catalog spec
summary: Prashant Singh called a vote to add finer grained read restrictions to the REST catalog spec, with the spec change in PR #13879. The vote message links the dedicated sync for the proposal, its recordings and notes, and proofs of concept for Spark end to end, Trino, Iceberg generics, actions and REST compatibility kit coverage, as well as earlier design documents and issues. The vote was to stay open for at least 72 hours. Sixteen replies arrived within about a day and all were +1, several thanking Singh for driving the work; Russell Spitzer remarked that the change had been a long time in the works. No concerns or objections were raised in the thread. The bundle contains no message that closes the vote or announces the result.

positions.stance: The REST catalog spec should adopt finer grained read restrictions as written in PR #13879.

outcome.note: No result message is in the thread. Votes cast: 4 binding +1 and 12 non-binding +1, with no 0 or -1 votes.

why_it_matters: Adoption would put read restrictions into the REST catalog spec, with engine-side proofs of concept already linked.
